title: QUIC RFC 9369 Version 2 Static Floor Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests, packet-parser and packet-protection unit tests, Retry-integrity unit tests, transport-parameter fuzz coverage where the versioned helpers parse attacker-controlled bytes, transport-parameter/header-parsing/Initial-protection/Retry-integrity benchmark dry runs, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene.
scope: This verification covers the RFC 9369 static QUIC v2 floor only. It proves version recognition, packet-type mapping, Initial packet protection, Retry integrity, and the hot-path benchmark evidence needed to keep the version-aware helper layer honest. It does not verify the RFC 9368 compatible-version restart/selection flow or any higher-layer application adaptation.
preconditions: The repository remains in the JSON-only SpecTrace workflow.
The RFC 9369 requirement-home tests exist under tests/Incursa.Quic.Tests/RequirementHomes/RFC9369.
The version-aware packet, Initial, and Retry helper paths remain version-bound and do not bleed v2 labels or secret material into the v1 floor.
expected_result: The focused RFC 9369 requirement-home tests pass, the packet-parser and packet-protection unit tests prove version-specific v2 behavior, the Retry-integrity tests prove version-aware keying and metadata binding, the transport-parameter and header-parsing benchmark dry runs complete, core SpecTrace validation accepts the JSON artifacts, the generated QUIC requirement coverage reports the RFC 9369 floor traceable, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: Passed. The RFC 9369 static QUIC v2 floor now has focused requirement-home proof, fuzz coverage, benchmark dry runs, generated coverage triage, and trace-validation refresh.
